profile.summary: I like to build products for everyday people.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Dec 2024 - present: Android engineer in Meta Superintelligence Labs. Working on the AI Studio Embodiment Team to bring AI characters to life via text, voice, and video. Working on Muse Voice and Embodiment.

Jan 2022 - Nov 2024: Android engineer on the Facebook Reels Consumption Growth team. Our goal is to introduce Reels to all people and connect them with entertaining short form video content that they want to watch every day.

Nov 2020 - Dec 2021: Android developer for a confidential wearables project in Reality Labs

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.locationName: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
positions.description:
Designed and developed a full stack price comparison web application using JavaScript, NodeJS, MongoDB, DataTables, HTML5, and CSS3 to be used by internal staff and by sellers who use the CDO website.
Wrote scripts in JavaScript to automate data insertions, updates, and deletions with respect to the company MySQL database to improve efficiency.

positions.title: McGraw Center for Teaching and Learning Peer Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored 25+ undergraduate students in Microeconomics in weekly 50-minute individual sessions and 3-hour group study hall sessions.
Liaised between instructors and undergraduate students to identify and clarify challenging concepts.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked in finance, budget, and product development for Wellness in the Schools, a national non-profit dedicated to “cook” and “coach” programs in public schools.
Wrote an original 47-page Salesforce User Guide based on interviews of internal employees and Salesforce representatives.
Conducted detailed financial research on over 20 potential grants by studying their accounting documents; created a budget for the company and pitched recommendations to executives.
Collaborated with a team of six to conceptualize, execute, monitor, and grow the activity of 3 publicity campaigns spanning Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.

positions.title: Brand Representative
positions.description:
• Increased sales by providing attentive customer service 
• Maintained cleanliness of the store and represented the brand in my demeanor and attire

positions.title: Junior Counselor
positions.description:
• Structured educational programs to aid in children’s character development 
• Cared for a group of nine kindergarteners by leading them in daily games and activities
• Created and executed original activities that enforce values such as respect, teamwork, and        kindness

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Prepared and led weekly Bible study for approximately ten high school girls
• Counseled and mentored youth group members

• Prepared hot meals for the impoverished people in the community every week in five hour shifts
• Led meal service alongside residents in the drug recovery program and other volunteers
